variants.name: game
variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an 8x nearest-neighbor enlargement of an existing 48x48 pixel dog sprite, variant A. Image 2 is the original dog face reference, image 3 standing reference. Refine ONLY the FACE and PAWS of image 1 for legibility at a genuine 48 BY 48 logical pixel resolution. Preserve the existing pose, direction, torso length, head size, all coat boundaries, overall silhouette, placement, margins, and transparent 48x48 canvas. No camera change, no cropping or zoom. This is hand-tuned low-resolution sprite cleanup, not a new detailed illustration. On the face: two distinct near-black eye clusters about 1-2 logical pixels each, tiny restrained highlights only if space permits; clear charcoal/black nose cluster 2-3 pixels wide; leave clean off-white separation between eye and nose; central white forehead blaze continuous into white muzzle; dark gray floppy ears distinct from white forehead. Use coherent 2-4 pixel clusters rather than scattered gray noise, preserve this individual's gray/white coat. On paws: make each visible paw a small connected off-white cluster with selective dark gray edge or gap distinguishing overlapping legs; keep feet grounded at original level; no extra toes, feet, spots or disconnected pixels. Do NOT add accessories, tongue, blush, outline around entire body, new markings, text, labels, cast shadow, environment, or checkerboard. Same neutral gray/off-white palette, genuine transparency. Render as an integer nearest-neighbor enlarged 48x48 sprite: every logical pixel a uniform hard-edged square, no antialiasing, blur, subpixel fur, gradient or photoreal detail. Head and torso must remain the exact original size, body pixels should be unchanged. Output a single square sprite, full transparent canvas, not a contact sheet.
